rdf:Description.skos:prefLabel: Refactor Graph Merging Logic from merge_graphs.py
rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the refactoring of the graph merging logic from `merge_graphs.py`. The logic will be moved into a new `GraphMerger` class in `gbad_core/graph_merger.py`.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote: **Relevant Code Snippets:** ```python def consolidate_rdf_files(input_dir, output_file): """ Read all supported RDF files in a directory and combine them into a single N-Quads file. """ # ... def create_named_graph_uri_from_file(file_path: Path, graph_uri_path: URIRef): # ... ```
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Create `GraphMerger` Class:** - Create a new class `GraphMerger` in `gbad_core/graph_merger.py`. 2. **Implement `merge()` Method:** - The `GraphMerger` class will have a `merge()` method that takes a list of file paths or `rdflib.Graph` objects and merges them into a single `rdflib.Dataset`. 3. **Preserve Provenance Logic:** - The logic for generating named graph URIs based on a SHA256 hash of the file content will be preserved in the new `GraphMerger` class.
